evals.name: triage-failed-deploy
evals.prompt: Check why my 'api' Komodo stack failed its latest deploy and inspect its container logs.
evals.expected_output: Calls komodo_health_check or komodo_stack_list/komodo_stack_info, checks komodo_update_list and komodo_update_info for the failed deploy stage, and inspects container logs via komodo_container_logs (fetching any ephemeral:// resource link if offloaded).
assertions: Uses komodo_update_list and komodo_update_info to diagnose the deploy failure
Uses komodo_container_logs (and handles ephemeral:// resource links or inline_full=true)
Does not attempt shell scripts or raw curl calls when komodo-mcp tools are available

evals.name: build-and-deploy-stack
evals.prompt: Trigger my 'webapp' Komodo build, wait/verify its build logs, and deploy the 'webapp' stack.
evals.expected_output: Checks komodo_build_list / komodo_build_info, triggers build via komodo_build_action(action='run'), inspects komodo_update_info / komodo_build_logs, then deploys via komodo_stack_action(action='deploy') and verifies container status.
assertions: Calls komodo_build_action with run and verifies completion via komodo_update_info or komodo_build_logs
Deploys stack via komodo_stack_action instead of creating an ad-hoc deployment
Respects pagination (_meta.page.next_cursor) if listing many resources

evals.name: read-only-http-mode-explanation
evals.prompt: Why are komodo_stack_action, komodo_exec, and komodo_stack_apply missing from tools/list when MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=false over HTTP?
evals.expected_output: Explains that open HTTP/HTTPS mode (MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=false) enforces a strict read-only invariant granting only komodo:read scope, hiding and rejecting all write/operate/admin/exec tools unless per-user HTTP auth is enabled or stdio is used.
assertions: Identifies the open-HTTP read-only invariant when MCP_AUTH_ENABLED=false
Also notes MCP_TOOLS_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES / EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES / EXCLUDED_TOOLS as potential server-side pruning causes
